verdict.line: You lose if you walk into his auto range without Q up and eat free Blinding Dart plus Toxic Shot poke; you win the moment you land Rupture into a trade or catch him inside Feast range past level 6.

brief.thesis: Teemo is ranged with a blind on an 8s cooldown and free poison stacking on every auto, so pre-6 trades favor him whenever Cho has to walk up without a tool to close the gap. Cho's whole kit is melee-range (Vorpal Spikes trigger on attack, Feast is 175 range), so the lane hinges on whether Cho can land Q (Rupture) to force the fight on his terms instead of Teemo's.

theirWindow.what: He can blind you before you reach auto range, shutting off your Vorpal Spikes damage while his Toxic Shot still ticks poison on you from his own autos. Don't initiate a stand-still trade here — he wins it for free.

yourWindow.when: right after he fires Blinding Dart
yourWindow.what: He has 8 seconds with no blind. Close the distance, land Q (Rupture) for the knockup and slow, then stack autos with E (Vorpal Spikes) and finish the trade with W (Feral Scream) to silence any Q he tries to flash-cooldown with. From level 6 on, follow this sequence into R (Feast) for a kill if he's below the true-damage threshold.

start.why: 57.4% win rate over 68 games and the regen plus block-on-hit sustain directly answers Teemo's poison-poke pattern better than a damage-first start in this lane.

boots.why: 47.7% win rate over 130 games; the magic resist blunts Toxic Shot's damage-over-time and Blinding Dart's upfront hit, both magic damage.

core.why: highest-winrate core path (58.3% over 12 games) and the gap-close lets you actually reach Teemo instead of eating poke on approach.

runes.keystoneWhy: 47.4% win rate over this page's sample; it rewards the slow melee trades this lane forces on you and matches OP.GG's own call to use your passive to manage health and win attrition.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite has the highest win rate of the three options at 51.8% over this sample; Ignite's guaranteed damage closes out trades against a squishy Teemo before his Camouflage reset or Move Quick lets him reposition.

playing.title: Hold spikes until Q lands
playing.detail: Don't walk into auto range to start stacking E (Vorpal Spikes) damage — land Q (Rupture)'s knockup and slow first so he can't just kite the whole fight.

playing.title: Trade only on his Q cooldown
playing.detail: Blinding Dart has an 8s cooldown; engaging while it's up means he blinds your autos away for free. Engage in the window right after he's used it.

playing.title: Track Camouflage resets
playing.detail: If Teemo stops moving for even a moment he can go invisible and reappear with an attack speed burst from Element of Surprise. Don't stand still in bushes near him pre-fight.

playing.title: Save W for his cooldowns
playing.detail: Feral Scream's silence (13s cooldown, 300 range) is best used mid-trade to shut down a Blinding Dart or a mushroom plant once you're already in his face.

playing.title: All-in at level 6 on overextension
playing.detail: Feast's true damage at 175 range can threaten lethal the moment he pushes past his minions. Bait him forward off a Rupture slow.

playing.title: Don't contest early poke damage
playing.detail: Toxic Shot procs on every one of his autos with no cooldown; trading autos at range before you have Rocketbelt just bleeds you for free.

playing.title: Play around mushroom vision loss
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has only a 1s cooldown to place, so expect zoning mushrooms in bushes and tri-brush — ward or sweep before committing to deep trades.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning for why each choice works in this matchup is my own tactical read, not sourced from the data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep your distance to avoid being punished by Teemo during early game. Use your skills to poke and [P] to manage your health to gain the upper hand in lane control.
